text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Sharp dispute between Netanyahu and Arafat over further redeployments in West Bank; Ross working on compromise.
- Defence Minister Mordechai to reconsider entrance permits given to members of the Palestine National Council who have not used them.
- Leading members of Netanyahu's Likud party: The party is crumbling.
- Netanyahu: Arafat and I made progress.
- Residents of Beit El settlement remove mobile homes, meet with Mordechai.
- Hebron settlers: Netanyahu will okay construction after pullback.
- Tel Aviv Stock Exchange jumps more than three percent.
- Soros increases holding in El-Rov to 14.4 percent.
- Netanyahu: I can make no more concessions to Arafat.
- Thousands of Israelis on UFO watch.
- Netanyahu agrees to additional redeployment within three months.
